from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_fg_master_crud_flow(page: Page):
    # Navigate directly to module page (assumes session pre-authenticated)
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("FG Master")')
    
    # Add New FG Item
    page.click('button:has-text("Add New")')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Enter FG item code"]', 'FG-AUTO-01')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Enter FG item name"]', 'Automated FG Item')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Width"]', '50')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Length"]', '100')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="GSM"]', '150')
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Minutes per unit"]', '10')
    page.click('button:has-text("Save")')
    
    # Search Created Item
    page.fill('input[placeholder="Search by FG Item Code, FG Item Name"]', 'FG-AUTO-01')
    expect(page.locator('table')).to_contain_text('FG-AUTO-01')
